QuestInfo.name: Preparing Picnic Food
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has a favor to ask of you, about the spring picnic.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator told you to bring her various foods and an #bEmpty Lunch Box#k. She also told you that the best place to find these is from monsters, so you'd best get hunting!
QuestInfo.2: You gave a bunch of food and an Empty Lunch Box to the Maple Administrator, and got a delicious Spring Picnic Lunch Box. If you receive more than 50 lunch boxes from the Maple Administrator, you could win a big prize!

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k! All of Maple World is looking forward to the upcoming spring picnic. Of course, you can't have a picnic without delicious food, right? How would you like to help me prepare some fantastic meals?
0.1: You can even get a reward for helping! That is, if you collect #r50 or more#k Picnic Lunch Boxes, #byou'll have a chance to win a nice prize through a drawing#k. Would you like to give it a try?

yes.0: Great! So, let's make a delicious Lunch Box. I'll tell you what we need, and you'll go get it, right?
yes.2: You can get the food and Empty Lunch Box by hunting normal monsters. Just make sure they are no more than #r10 levels higher or lower than your level#k, okay? Be sure to check the #blevels of the monsters#k you fight.
yes.3: Oh, and #rmonsters that are Level 150 or higher#k will drop special food and lunch boxes, regardless of the character's level. So, if you think you're strong enough, you can always try hunting the big ones!
yes.4: And one last thing... #bAll the food you have gathered could disappear if you log out#k, so be sure to bring it to me before you leave!
yes.5: If you bring me what I've asked for, then I will make you a delicious picnic Lunch Box, #b#ho##k!

no.0: Won't the picnic be a bit of a drag without great food? I do hope you'll reconsider.

1.0: Are you ready? Let me see... Yes, it looks like you brought everything! Now, wait just a minute, and I will make a delicious Lunch Box for you.

yes.0: I hope you enjoyed the picnic Lunch Box. I can always make you another if you bring me and Empty Lunch Box and some food, so let me know if you're interested in more.

item.0: I'm afraid you don't quite have everything I need. Please hurry, so you can get your food sooner!
